lines: Quincy's voice lines and sound effects. Quincy occasionally uses British slang and colloquialisms and Jamaican Patois.

- "Oi. Listen. Me and a few suppliers in the neighborhood got a side hustle going. Ink, threads, weapons, whatever, but this stays between you and me, right? Soldier boy hears about it, he goes chapter-and-verse and nobody gets nothing."
- "Arthur: field-strip done. Headin' out in a bit to clear me head."
- "Eleanor, it don't help me havin' your toys eyeball my shooters like they wanna make friends. It's giving me the heebie-jeebies."
- "Amir: got a job for you. Shelters need deliveries. Get your game face on."
- "Yo Lettie. Lemme know what we're short on, fold it into the scav order for the outer sectors. I'm headin' out in a bit, see what I can find."
- "Aoi! Before I forget: contact a mine has a lead on a clothing pallet he swears is legit shibukaji (渋カジ). If Eleanor's in range when I eyeball 'em I'll get her to pipe you a look."
- "Big up yaself (yourself). Dress for the hitter you wanna be."
- "Nice enough shooter. But I reckon we can bling it, yeah?"
- "Get you sorted wit' threads, bling, ink, ya feel me?"
- "So, what you tryin' to do after this?"
- "Look, don't try to speech me. Just tell me what ya want, and I'll tell ya what I'm askin'."
- "You need some threads, unless you want to look like your Mum dressed you?"
- "All good, no funny business. Everyting's bless, seen?"
- "Step correct and I'll show you the A-grade shit."
- "Stasis is death, yeah. Change? Is life. Law of nature. Law of style. Fundamental."
- "Listen. Me? I can only dress you. It's you who's gotta wear it."
- "I dress for who I am, right? And who I am starts where comparison ends."
- "Nothin' wrong with a little vanity, innit?"
- "Yeah. Quincy-K all 'bout takin' what's fine 'bout all of this? And weaponizin' it."
- "Modern... classic... you know I got it all."
- "Arthur asks any questions, you found that, read me?"
- "That'll make my connection happy. Bloke's got a family."
- "Alright, now get outta here before someone sees us."
- "Took a lot of trouble to get that. Take good care of it."
- "Okay, okay, I don't want no smoke."
- "Gotta do what you gotta do, innit."
- "A lie yuh a tell (A lie you're telling). Ah, move and gweh (go away)."
- "Oi, this level of panache? That's effort, yo. Try it sometime."
- "Go get yourself a payday loan then."
- "Shit like this flies off the shelves. Don't sleep on it."
- "Huh. S'a (It's a) right mare (nightmare (colloquial)) gettin' a scrub to scrub up (dress up (informal)), know what I mean?"
- "Respect. How can I be of service?"
- "Yo, what you sayin' fam? You cool?"
- "Drifter. What you tryin' to do after?"
- "Wait 'til the rest of the mandem (men) come. Hit the bar, tie one on (get drunk (idiom)), yeah?"
- "I was wondering when you'd ask... But... Are you sure about this?"
- "Yeah babes - let's go. You n' me, time to make everyone jealous."
- "You learned your lesson, yeah? Remember I don't like having my time wasted. You don't get three strikes with Q."
- "You gotta stop with all this will-you-won't-you bollocks."
- "Wait, you think I'd be caught dead with you? I've got a reputation to maintain."
- "You're breaking up with me? As in me! You must be joking, yeah?"
- "Suit yourself. You'll learn you made a mistake real quick. They always do."
- "Yo! I was being mighty nice forgiving you the first time. This time? We're done."
- "Came to your senses. Oh. Good. Now piss off."
- "Look what you do to me, comin' round lookin' like that. S'a (It's a) crime how you make me feel."
- "What is this beauty I see before me? How you doin', babe? You got somethin' for me?"
- "Ooo! You looking good today. You change your hair or somethin'? C'mere."
- "Y'know me. All about moments. Make this one last a little longer."
- "You know these hands don't feel right when they ain't on you. Aaah where you goin'?!"
- "Hey. Why you always smell so good? Damn. Could bottle that shit up, for real."
- "¡Vamos! ¡Vamos! ¡Vamos! (Let's go! (x3)) Lettie said I need more practice."
- "Every time one of 'em balloons pop pop pop in the mall, speeds up the heart. Gonna give me a heart attack."
- "Promise I won't leave no holes in the bricks here."
- "I see you, and I know you see me."
- "How's a man supposed to focus? With you giving me those looks."
- "Brave to walk right past me without a kiss."
- "You know I've a tattoo? Wonder if it survived the Entrati swap. You'll have to go looking around, for it?"
- "One of the stray kids out there told me they saw you practicing with my gear? Flattered."
- "So that Entrati then, he's just gone? Like gone gone."
- "Too many screens around here. These machines ever give you problems? It's on sight."
- "Need an umbrella today? Don't want you catching nothing out there. Nothing worse anyway."
- "Since you're such a quick learner, I'm wondering if I can teach you a thing or two over here."
- "I'm not mindin' the vibes here. Especially now that you're back."
- "Mind if I move some books in? A couple of favs would look good right there."
- "You can be quite the little songbird, can't you."
- "Run along, if I catch you, hm, well let's say you won't get much done today will you?"
- "Ah! Too many screens in here, always blinding me at night."
- "Not wrong to use a bullet as a bookmark, is it?"
- "Magazines everywhere, I'm thinking you don't have many of those where you're from. So how's this headline sound: "Ready for your daily Vitamin Q"? Ha. Slick right?"
- "Let's not forget to practice proper weapon discipline? Grip steady and firm, take a deep breath. Yeah."
- "Worse case scenario out there, I can get the job done with just a finger."
- "Storybooks. Been going through 'em since day one at school. Never felt that I'd be thinking about them now, but I'm reminding myself of that prince who did get his happy ending."
- "No judgment, but I do think some of those Zariman suits would look better on me. Or on the floor."
- "I got a bullet with his name on it. E.N.T.R.A.T.I. I'm holding on to it though. Maybe it'll be the last bullet I ever fire, then what, we can just be somewhere else. Someone else."
- "It's about who you find, who has your back. I'm not writing any of them off, not even the kid. I think, well, I think we're proving something, aren't we? All of us. And I want to play my part."
- "I know some people out there trade in information. But wonder how the channels would light up if word spread about what we did last night? Would be easy to make them all jealous, wouldn't it?"

- "You think one of us should be out there trying to give the strays an education? Those kids, they've got a whole life to learn. If you don't mind, maybe I can take some time, show them the shadows don't gotta be so scary?"
- "I've made my peace with it. The clock. The calendar. Seeming more like a music track than an expiry date for us, right? Like we beat some game we didn't even know we were playing."
- "My favorite little trigger to squeeze. Not too tightly wound today, are you? Since we have this, all this, maybe you need an inspection? Promise to keep it proper."
- "Feels like we're starting our own 'Once upon a time' type story. Except we know that this gets a happily ever after on repeat, repeat and repeat."
- "Don't need my scope to see how right this all is. Sure, people might get the idea that I have a weakness now, that being you, but ha, who could take us?"
- "Hmm.. Just glad, hm? Not "scared you can't keep up with me" or "worried you'll have trouble walking tomorrow"?"
- "It's more than alright with me. This is where I want to be."
- "Mmm, not a minute I haven't loved. See I used to think I knew warmth when Sol woke me up. Now I know real warmth comes from seeing you."
- "Still can't believe, out of all your options in the universe... I haven't managed to cock this up yet. But I always know how to make it right."
- "Me, too. You have any idea how cuddly you get when you sleep? Cutest damn thing I've ever seen."
- "You 'n me, against the whole universe. Kinda love the sound of that, yeah? ... Yeah okay and fine, the rest of them can come, too. I guess."
- "Used to be worried, thinking if I wasn't the one playing, somebody was gunna be the one playing me. Never been so happy to be wrong..."
> new year is comin, u want 2 celebrate?
> just u and me, private, no stress
- "Look at this then, us. This is my reward for being such a good boy, then?"
- "A moment of peace. Trust me there's nothing I wouldn't do to protect this peace."
- "You're too good to me. Every part of you."
- "That enough for you? Always know where to find me for more."
- "No mask here, no tricks. What we've got will be setting the standard for the future, seen?"
- "Hold up, hero boy. You're going after Doctor E all by yourself?"
- "Found a hole in its shield, Arthur!"
- "Check me out. Givin' kit to Entrati's Cybercop."
- "Naw. More like V-1000. Sent to smoke us all, am I right?"
- "Lotta heat here in the opp-block, Arthur. You sure Marty's lead isn't just a setup? You holding something back, heroboy?"
- "I told you this was a set-up!"
- "Didn't come out here to cut an' hide. If Doctor E won't stop this, then I say we do it. Am I right, Amir? AMIR?"
- "Likkle (Little) Amir knows all about these opps and their systems. A proper boss like you is smart enough to figure it out, innit, Marty?"
- "What did you do, Amir? Come in? Comm's dead."
- "Nice score you got us here, Arthur. But you know what? I've had my fill of the circus. I'm out."
- "You are proper shit at directions, Arthur. Heads down while I do my job, arright mate?"
- "Not today, momma. Area secure. Godspeed, Amir!"
- "Man ain't nothin' without his mains. Respec'.
- "Scaldra purge-squad thought to sweep the block, got smoked. So, we're cleaning up their whole damn mess. Make things right. Seen?"
- "Techrot's off the charts. Full-grown, full-blown. Scaldra patties can't do nothing 'bout it. It's all on us. You wanna play exterminator, fam? Yea, get in there."
- "Scaldra came here, tryna (trying to) fix a mess they made. Wet boys took one look and legged it. We gonna fix this. We gonna make the block right. Feel me? Let's go."
- "Scaldra ops came to purge the block. Tried and died. Now? Quarantine. Civvies got no chance 'less we do the purge ourselves. Hear me? Cutters and shooters gripped. Time to hunt."
- "Sector's vexed. TVs gone mental mashin' up everything they see. 'Bout time come we discipline the horror. All of em, we put em in the ground, feel me?"
- "Halfway there, on the job. No quit."
- "Line em up and cut 'em down. We're half done."
- "Yo, Techrot signals down to fifty percent. Take 'em to zero."
- "You're clearing 'em out. Bet it smells better n'all."
- "Ain't no man gettin' bested by no techrotted fax machine."
- "You proper sent the Techrot back to the stone age. Now bring it home, fam."
- "You got the worst of it. Now come on home, fam."
- "Over-and-out, fam. Job's a good'un (Job's done (colloquial)). Nice one."
- "Ain't nobody gon' mess with the Hex now. Not Scaldra, not Techrot. Ya' feel me? Now extract yourself."
- "Gotta solid move: abandoned supply cache. Now listen up: if you get close, it'll clock you, and start a countdown. Bust into the cache before it's smoked. Seen?"
- "Scaldra supply cache in the area. You get near, it will start ticking. Self-destruct. Need to be quick to get the goods."
- "Yo! Supply cache clocked you. Efervon Charge or two will melt that lock proper."
- "Supply cache flipped into self-destruct. Get worksy. A few Efervon Charges should pop it. But know this, open that thing and the Techrot'll get riled up crazy."
- "Techrot's proper pissed off. Hitters coming out of every nook and crook. I say; let 'em come."
- "Fam, Techrot's well mad. Situation's 'bout to get proper mental."
- "Supplies destroyed. Pick up the pace next time, yeah?"
- "I'm game. Well bored bein' posted up."
- "When you need the job done proper, yeah?"
- "Drop me in the field - expect mayhem."
- "Imma do this calm. Imma do this cold. Ya feel me?"
- "'Bout time, need to get proper cruddy. Bones itchin'."
- "Come, let's cut. Just you 'n' me, yeah?"
- "Yo. What you tryin' to do after?"
- "This feels proper wrong (completely wrong). Probly why I like it. (Probably (slang) why I like it)"
- "You 'n me, against all of them? Babe, them fools are gonna get shaved."
- "Dem opps (Them ops) got no hope. You 'n' me? We got this patterned."
- "Okay, okay. We ride. But later, I need me some skin."
- "Babe, geezer messes with you? Straight merked (murked (slang)). Boom."
- "Here's how this works: you need me, you call. Feel me?"
- "Um, I had… partners… get in my head before, but not like this. I kinda… like it."
- "Damn, babe. You got a real feel for me."
- "Yo, later we hit a movie, blag (steal (slang)) a two-for-one, yeah? Just messin'. Films are dead."
- "Sure sure, but after this: you, me, long shower, a few drinks… what you sayin'?"
- "Glidin'? Scoped the opp block, yeah? Gotta do what you gotta do, innit?"
- "Gonna need to polish my rifle after this. Take that how you like." [Note: the game is currently using placeholder text-to-speech audio]
- "One of these days imma take you on a proper date. Flowers, candles, all that good shit. I promise."
- "Off wit ya, just like that, yeah?"
- "Yeah yeah. I see how it is."
- "So, what? I jus' stand 'round the gaff lookin' bad? (I just stand around the crib/home (slang) looking good?) Waste."
- "I'll just stand 'round and count sheep, then, yeah?"
- "Don't get yourself killed while you're out, chief."
- "Nah, do you. I got this patterned."
- "Merchandise untrammeled, for which I thank you."
- "Fair warning: if you scuffed the finish I'll be pissed."
- "No faffing about (fucking around (slang)), you ain't so tough without me."
- "Arright yeah. Come on in. Make y'self comfortable n'at."
- "I'll be just over your shoulder, if you need anythin'."
- "Opps (Ops (spec-ops, slang)) pullin' up on us for real! Rise!"
- "That's why we step out strapped! Let rip!"
- "Talent's wasted on these muppets for real."
- "Could win gold for that. No lie."
- "I oughta leave survivors or I'm never buildin' a rep."
- "Did you see that? Mate? Oh. Right."
- "Oi! I got sauced! Help me out, man!"
- "Oi! Get me up, you pillock (fool (derogratory, slang))!"
- "You waiting for an invite or what? Get me up!"
- "You lot need me, get me up!"
- "Oi! You cuttin' without me? Gimme a hand!"
- "Don't you leg it without me, you prick!"
- "Oi! What, you gonna let me die here?"
- "Aaagh! Don't just stand there, get me up!"
- "Oi! I got got! Oi! Cloth-ears! I'm hit ain't I!"
- "I'm hit! You got a man down here!"
- "Hey! No man left behind! Flippin' law of the battlefield, right? Hey!"
- "Oi. Oi! Get the mandem 'fore they come back, yeah!"
- "Drop what you're doing and help me!"
- "Thanks. Takes more than one of them fools to get me."
- "Yeah, thanks. Feel a right arse, still."
- "Thanks. Reckon they're proper bad, don't they?"
- "They're gonna regret not finishing me off. Safe."
- "Man ain't nothin' without his mains. Respec'."
- "Thanks for the lift, fam. Gonna make them pay for that."
- "Proper certy, man. All good, I'll sleep this off."
- "I'm gonna make them feel for that one."
- "Yeah yeah thanks. Whatcha want: a medal?"
- "This stays between you and me, seen? Man's got a reputation."
- "Easy. Sol's tits, where'd you learn your bedside manner?"
- "Havin' a proper mare (nightmare (colloquial)) with these ops, ya feel me? I'm good."
- "Bagga dem (A lot of them), fam! Light 'em up!"
- "Opps in the field. (Ops (spec-ops, slang) in the field.)"
- "Situation blows but I like the ride."

path: Höllvania Central Mall 2024 Demo Idle Quotes
lines: - "You don't know me. Never see what darkens your rooftops. Inevitable, like the rain. Handing out consolations in a transient connection. Boom. Smoke. And ghost."
- "Don't mind the waiting. Plenty to be thinking about."
- "Arthur needs to leave the Major to me, innit. Respect my methods."
- "Amir is a weak, weak boy. Little Aunty said, "duppy know who fi frighten. (a ghost knows who to scare)""
- "How many man have the opps got? Not enough t'be takin' me. Never."
- "You wiv (with) me, Eleanor? How deep in you go? See anythin' you fancy, girl?"
- "Oi, Lettie! Grab y' strap (Grab your gun (slang)) and let's go! Best a five buys the drinks?"
